name: Street View House Numbers (SVHN)
description: The Street View House Numbers (SVHN) dataset is a real-world image benchmark obtained from house numbers in Google Street View images. It contains over 600,000 labeled character digits formatted in both full-resolution images with bounding boxes and cropped 32x32 pixel images.
